   void operator()(std::ptrdiff_t first, std::ptrdiff_t last) const final {
     ptrdiff_t len = last - first;
+#if defined(__wasm_simd128__)
+    if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, float>) {
+      if (this->input == this->output && len >= 4) {
+        float* p = this->output + first;
+        const v128_t scale = wasm_f32x4_splat(alpha);
+        const v128_t zero = wasm_f32x4_splat(0.0f);
+        const ptrdiff_t vector_end = len - len % 4;
+        ptrdiff_t i = 0;
+        for (; i < vector_end; i += 4) {
+          const v128_t x = wasm_v128_load(p + i);
+          const v128_t product = wasm_f32x4_mul(scale, x);
+          const v128_t nonnegative = wasm_f32x4_ge(x, zero);
+          wasm_v128_store(p + i, wasm_v128_bitselect(x, product, nonnegative));
+        }
+        for (; i < len; ++i) {
+          const float x = p[i];
+          p[i] = x >= 0.0f ? x : alpha * x;
+        }
+        return;
+      }
+    }
+#endif
     T* output_ptr = this->output + first;
     ConstEigenVectorArrayMap<T> xm(this->input + first, len);
     EigenVectorArrayMap<T> ym(output_ptr, len);
